# Retained Unified Agenda example

`edition-202510.xml` copies the exact two-record fixture from SpicyDocs
`tests/fixtures/unified_agenda/reginfo-rin-data-202510.xml` so installed RefSpec
tests can run independently. It preserves the first two records and root
attributes of the Fall 2025 export captured on 2026-09-14.

- Fixture SHA-256: `95bb0fc531bc79b6f0582096ecb1485d01aba79082350056ff07120f64825c83`
- Full export SHA-256: `4dc85fe08251eed1499dee5f2a2f7e3fcf4717baf468409c1f884dd68782b75f`
- [Publisher export](https://www.reginfo.gov/public/do/XMLViewFileAction?f=REGINFO_RIN_DATA_202510.xml)

The fixture includes a planned `11/00/2026` date and embedded HTML in CDATA.
It is comparison evidence, not a complete edition or a repaired source.
